# X509_WEBHOOK

The certificate controller's admission webhook is serving, so its CRs are accepted.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `webhook`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.webhook`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

| namespace | kubernetes name (DNS-1123 label) |
